_comment: Manual/researched tourism-association seed URLs per municipality code, merged into the daily crawl seeds (scrapers/daily.ts) on top of tourism_org_urls.json. Committed to git so it survives HF regeneration of tourism_org_urls.json. Fills municipalities that automated discover:tourism_orgs missed — their tourism content lives on an official association / DMO / municipal-tourism site that the city-hall page does not link to. Official/public sources only (観光協会 / DMO / city-authorized tourism portals); no OTAs, blogs, or UGC. 'note' flags borderline judgment calls for reviewers.
